context: Ren and Kenji talk about renting a workspace.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: work chat; vocabulary (借り/置か/住む/流し/我が) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 作業部屋を、借りようと思うんです。
lines.en: I'm thinking of renting a workroom.
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: どの辺に、借りるんですか?
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今住んでいる、近くがいいです。
lines.en: Near where I live now would be good.
lines.style: thoughtful young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 機材は、どこに置くんですか?
lines.en: Where will you put the equipment?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 壁際に、棚を置く予定です。
lines.en: I plan to put a shelf by the wall.
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 小さな流しも、あると便利ですよ。
lines.en: A small sink is handy to have too.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 流し付きの部屋を、探します。
lines.en: I'll look for a room with a sink.
lines.style: resolved young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 我が社の近くだと、通いやすいですね。
lines.en: Near our company, it'd be easy to commute.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
